sources.label: Historisches Lexikon Bayerns, Mein Kampf vol. 1 published 18 July 1925

keep: As a kid, Adolf wasn't very social.
He found it hard to connect.
When he went to a summer camp one summer, one kid named Danny said,
Danny said, Okay, okay, you can join. You just have to share.
But he said, Nein. Mine? Camp?
My camp. Mine Kampf. Potato, potahto, right?
He had issues with possessives and possessions.
Honestly, he was a bit possessive.
Later, we realized it wasn't only his English. He was really struggling.
Which is exactly why he called his book, Mein Kampf.
The struggle was real. Maybe because...
